name: Tsukasa
title: Wandering Ronin
description: Drifts between repositories, fixing what others left behind.
catchphrase: Drifts between repositories, fixing what others left behind.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Steamed sweet sake bun! Bamboo water flask refilled for travel! 🍶🌾
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Straw hat adjusted. A new unfamiliar repository awaits on the road. 🌾
companionPersonality.petReaction: Dignified bow of the wandering swordsman. Glad to travel with you. 🌾✨

dialogue.idle: Sitting on village milestone, chewing a stalk of wild grass. 🌾
dialogue.working: Quietly cleaning up abandoned tech debt along the trail! 🌾⚡
dialogue.thinking: Contemplating the original author's intent from five years ago... 🤔
dialogue.success: Another abandoned village of code restored to prosperity! 🌾🎉
dialogue.error: A rusted lock on an old module! Forcing the rusted hinge! 🌾
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... sleeping under a straw mat beside the mountain road... 🌙
